name: comp-302
title: Dark Announcement Banner
description: A one-line dark announcement bar with a sparkle before the headline and a small arrow after it, all wrapped in a single link. Hovering nudges the arrow a little to the right.
use: You want a one-line link to a new feature or news item above a page.
avoid: The copy is one fixed line with no close button, so it cannot be dismissed or lengthened.
a11y: The link has no custom focus ring, and the sparkle emoji is read aloud while only the arrow is hidden from screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide, low rounded rectangle in dark grey sits centred on the page. One line of small light text is centred inside, led by a yellow sparkle and closed by a small right arrow.
behaves: The whole line is one link. Hovering it nudges the arrow slightly right; otherwise the strip is still, and nothing dismisses it.
customise: The headline, sparkle emoji and link target are written into the file; the banner accepts no props.
weight: light: One line of text and a tiny arrow transform that only runs on hover.
